/* CSS to Enumerate the Reference List */
/* Apply counter reset to both the main refs div and our custom refs-other div */
#refs, #refs-other {
counter-reset: pub-counter;
}

div.csl-entry {
position: relative;
padding-left: 0em;
margin-bottom: 1em;
}

div.csl-entry:before {
counter-increment: pub-counter;
content: counter(pub-counter) ".";
position: relative;
left: 0;
top: 0;
font-weight: bold;
width: 2em;
text-align: right;
}
</style>

## Other publications

[Download other references (.bib)](assets/bib/other_publications.bib){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import subprocess
import os
import re

# Path to the secondary bibliography
bib_file = "assets/bib/other_publications.bib"
# Use the same CSL style as the main document
csl_url = "http://www.zotero.org/styles/apa-cv"

if os.path.exists(bib_file):
    # We construct a minimal markdown input that requests all citations
    input_md = "---\nnocite: '@*'\n---"
    
    # We run pandoc explicitly on the other bibliography file
    # This ensures we get the exact same formatting as the main list
    cmd = [
        "pandoc",
        "--from=markdown",
        "--to=html",
        "--citeproc",
        f"--bibliography={bib_file}",
        f"--csl={csl_url}"
    ]
    
    try:
        # Run pandoc to generate the bibliography HTML fragment
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            input=input_md,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        html_output = result.stdout
        
        # The output contains <div id="refs" ...>. We want to rename it to #refs-other
        # to avoid ID conflicts and allow separate CSS counter resetting.
        html_output = re.sub(r'id="refs"', 'id="refs-other"', html_output)
        
        # Ensure it has the same classes as the main list for consistent styling
        # The standard output usually has "references csl-bib-body hanging-indent"
        # We append "refs-ordered" to match the user's styling hooks
        if 'class="references csl-bib-body hanging-indent"' in html_output:
            html_output = html_output.replace(
                'class="references csl-bib-body hanging-indent"', 
                'class="references csl-bib-body hanging-indent refs-ordered"'
            )
        
        # Print the HTML directly into the document
        print(html_output)
        
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"<!-- Error processing other publications: {e} -->")
        if e.stderr:
            print(f"<!-- Stderr: {e.stderr} -->")
        print("<p><em>Could not generate other publications list.</em></p>")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print("<!-- Error: pandoc not found. -->")
        print("<p><em>Could not generate list (pandoc missing).</em></p>")
else:
    print(f"<!-- File not found: {bib_file} -->")
    print("<p><em>No other publications found.</em></p>")

```
